test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 6% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per year

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (2500 × 6 × 2) / 100

⇒ SI = (2500 × 12) / 100

⇒ SI = 300

**The simple interest is ₹300.**
